title: Edge capacity sprint — early shift journal
content:
2026-03-11 early shift (06:30–10:30)
Quick context: sprinting on edge reclaim + burst capacity tuning for us-west-2 pools. Running a focused pass today to reduce cold-starts for small batches and reclaim idle GPUs flagged by the metrics alerts.

Primary goals:
- Stabilize us-west-2/edge-pool-3 latency (p90 target < 120ms).
- Reclaim idle GPUs in rack-7 and free capacity for Dedicated test jobs.
- Verify autoscaler cooldown change (PR 1182) in canary cluster.

Top-priority checklist (quick actionable items):
1) Validate alert context
   - Check recent spikes: grafana dashboard -> edge/latency-usw2 (last 3h).
   - Query: sum(rate(request_latency_bucket[5m])) by (instance) to spot noisy hosts.
2) Run dry reclaim on rack-7 (non-destructive)
   - Script: infra/scripts/edge/reclaim-dry-run.sh --rack rack-7 --age 45m
   - Expected: list of pods eligible, no evictions.
3) If dry-run looks good, trigger reclaim (manual):
   - infra/scripts/edge/reclaim.sh --rack rack-7 --min-free-gpu 1
   - Watch: kubectl get pods -n edge -o wide --field-selector=status.phase=Pending
4) Canary autoscaler change
   - PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1182 (Samir)
   - Canary cluster: canary-usw2-edge-01
   - Steps: deploy PR, send synthetic load (wrk) for 10m, check scale events in k8s-event log.
   - Rollback: kubectl rollout undo deploy/hpa-controller -n infra if error rate > 2%

Quick command snippets (paste-ready):
- check gpu usage: ssh rack-7-node-02 "nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,utilization.gpu,temperature.gpu --format=csv,noheader,nounits"
- list pods on node: kubectl get pods -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=rack-7-node-02 -n edge
- drain node safely: kubectl drain rack-7-node-02 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
- revert autoscaler: kubectl -n infra rollout undo deploy/hpa-controller

Important thresholds / heuristics (notes for later automation):
- Consider marking GPUs idle if < 3% utilization for 30+ minutes and no scheduled Dedicated jobs pending.
- Avoid reclaim if node._recent_eviction_count > 2 in last hour (prevents flapping).
- Cold-start penalty measured: 1.6x latency increase for first 5 tokens when container was cold > 10m.

Observations from quick triage (06:50):
- Rack-7 node-02 shows 0% GPU util for last 48m, owned by batch-sim old jobs (stuck in Terminating).
- HPA metrics look noisy around 05:40–06:10 correlating with scheduled ci-load spike.
- Canary cluster had one scale-to-zero event (expected), but pods didn't wake up within target SLO.

Immediate actions taken (06:55–07:20):
- Kicked dry-run reclaim -> flagged 6 pods on node-02 as reclaimable (batch-sim old).
- Escalated to Samir via DM: "hold reclaim until we confirm Terminating stuck cause" (he's looking at kubelet logs).
- Deployed a temporary increase to warm-pool size for canary: api call -> POST /internal/warm-pool {pool: canary-usw2-edge-01, target: 2} (manual step, revert later).

Notes-to-self / troubleshooting hints:
- If Terminating pods hang: check for open lvms mount or containerd-shim stuck. Use: sudo crictl ps -a | grep <container-id> and sudo crictl stopp <id> then crictl rm <id>.
- Node kubelet OOM patterns often coincide with kernel dmesg "Out of memory" messages—grab dmesg and systrace.
- For nvidia persistence daemon restarts: systemctl status nvidia-persistenced; journalctl -u nvidia-persistenced -n 200.

Unresolved questions / follow-ups:
- Why did warm pool not serve first-request quickly on canary? Hypothesis: container image pull + compressed layers. Need image size audit (Samir to run: docker images --format "{{.Repository}} {{.Size}}" on builders).
- Should we lower autoscaler cooldown from 300s -> 180s for edge pools? Will test after this sprint.
- Can we add a lightweight health-check endpoint that cold-containers hit on startup to pre-warm attention caches? (proto idea: /init-health triggers a tiny warmup of KV cache)

End-of-shift quick wrap (10:20):
- What I did: dry-run reclaim, temporarily bumped canary warm-pool, monitored scale events, collected logs for one Terminating pod.
- What next: follow up with Samir and Maya for: (a) confirm safe reclaim window, (b) run image size audit, (c) schedule controlled test lowering cooldown.
- Hand-off note: leave alert runbook link in slack thread + mark INF-4823 for tracking.

Done list (ticks):
- [x] Dry-run reclaim (rack-7)
- [x] Notify on-call (Samir) and escalate Terminating issue
- [x] Temporary warm-pool increase for canary
- [ ] Actual reclaim (blocked)
- [ ] Image size audit
- [ ] Autoscaler cooldown A/B test

Random quick ideas (brain-dump):
- Add a "reclaim-safe" label that automation checks for (prevents reclaiming nodes with recent evictions).
- Metric: track "cold-start penalty" per image hash, store in time-series for rollout decisions.
- Small CLI: infractl edge status --short returns node/gpu/idle-hrs to help triage from phone.

Sign-off: Olivia (06:30 shift)
summary: Early-shift scratchpad for edge capacity sprint: dry-run reclaim, canary warm-pool tweak, autoscaler canary, commands/thresholds, observations and follow-ups.
